name: Encryption at rest
controls: Azure Policy: Storage accounts should use customer-managed key / infrastructure encryption
fix: Enable platform-managed or customer-managed encryption on every data store.

name: Encryption in transit
controls: Azure Policy: Secure transfer to storage accounts should be enabled
fix: Require HTTPS/TLS 1.2+ and disable plain HTTP endpoints.

name: Approved region
fix: Deploy only to approved US regions: eastus, eastus2, centralus.

name: No public endpoints for restricted data
controls: CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark 4.1.1 (public network access)
fix: Disable public network access or front the service with Private Endpoint.

name: Diagnostic logging enabled
controls: Azure Policy: Diagnostic logs should be enabled
fix: Send resource logs to a Log Analytics workspace.

name: Business owner and cost center tagged
controls: Azure Policy: Require a tag on resources
fix: Provide a named business owner and a cost center.

name: Managed identity, no stored secrets
controls: Azure Policy: Function apps / App Service should use managed identity
fix: Use a system-assigned managed identity instead of keys or connection strings.

name: Restricted data requires security approval
fix: A security approver must sign off before deployment.
